{{Quote|But have you seen the strength of the revolution? Cells on Nar Shaddaa, Tholatin, Molavar, Alderaan, Balmorra&hellip; it's an inspiration, no matter how it ends.|The Eagle|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Eagle's network''' was a terrorist group led by [[Eagle]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], that was secretly backed by [[Darth Jadus]]. Later known as the '''Eradicator network''', it included cells on a number of [[Planet/Legends|planets]], such as [[Tholatin]], [[Molavar/Legends|Molavar]], [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], and [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. The [[Balmorran resistance]] had ties to the network, and the [[ghost cell]] was one of the network's training cells. [[VerveGen Corporation]] was purchased to serve as a front company for the group to procure [[Cyclone]], and [[House Cortess]] was one of the group's backers. The network was eventually defeated by [[Cipher Nine]] and its plans for the [[Eradicator (weapon)|Eradicators]] were averted.
